structural_engineering_lib

Purpose
- Route-specific IS 456:2000 reinforced-concrete design and checking library.
- Supported beam, column, isolated-footing, and bounded solid-slab workflows.
- Design -> compliance -> detailing -> DXF/BBS/report outputs.
- Full-stack: React 19 frontend + FastAPI backend + Python core library.

Install
- pip install structural-lib-is456
- pip install "structural-lib-is456[dxf]"  # optional DXF support

Python import
- from structural_lib import api

CLI (python -m structural_lib)
- capabilities : show supported/held workflows, units, and review boundaries
- design  : design beams from CSV/JSON -> results JSON
- bbs     : generate bar bending schedule from results JSON
- dxf     : generate DXF drawings from results JSON (requires ezdxf)
- job     : run job spec JSON -> output folder
Command discovery: run python -m structural_lib --help and python -m structural_lib <cmd> --help for full options.

V3 Stack
- React 19 + React Three Fiber + Tailwind CSS (react_app/)
- FastAPI REST + WebSocket backend (fastapi_app/)
- Python structural_lib core (Python/structural_lib/)
- Docker deployment (docker-compose.yml)

Key API Endpoints (FastAPI) — 88 endpoints across 26 routers
- GET /api/v1/library/capabilities - Canonical supported/held contract
- POST /api/v1/design/beam - Beam design (Mu, Vu, Ast)
- POST /api/v1/design/beam/check - Check existing design
- POST /api/v1/detailing/beam - Rebar detailing
- POST /api/v1/import/csv - CSV import with adapters (40+ columns)
- POST /api/v1/import/dual-csv - ETABS dual CSV import
- POST /api/v1/geometry/beam/full - 3D rebar/stirrup positions
- POST /api/v1/insights/dashboard - Batch analytics
- POST /api/v1/optimization/beam/cost - Cost optimization
- POST /api/v1/export/bbs|dxf|report - File downloads
- WS /ws/design/{session_id} - Live WebSocket updates
- GET /health - Health check
- GET /docs - OpenAPI auto-generated documentation

Notes
- Units: mm, N/mm^2, kN, kN-m (convert at boundaries)
- Run python -m structural_lib capabilities --json for the canonical capability contract.
- Every listed design capability retains its declared held cases and qualified-review requirement.
- 4-layer architecture: Core types -> IS 456 Code (pure math) -> Services (orchestration) -> UI/IO (interfaces)
- Python/structural_lib/api.py is a backward-compat stub — real code is in services/api.py
